propositions: Rebar requires a native Bedrock provider integration that does not rely on an OpenAI-compatible gateway, to preserve prompt caching and structured output capabilities.

Bedrock prompt caching must be verified per model and rebar must emit a warning when caching is requested but both cache_read_tokens and cache_write_tokens remain zero, since failure is silent and causes full-price billing on every call.

Some Bedrock models (measured: us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7) reject the temperature sampling parameter with a 400 ValidationException, but pydantic-ai's BedrockConverseModel lacks the _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings protection that exists in the Anthropic path, causing hard failures on rebar's Pass-2 verify steps that deliberately send temperature=0.

The default documented Bedrock model must be an inference-profile ARN (verified: us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 caches; plain on-demand model ids are not invokable in measured account/region), and a new capability flag supports_temperature must selectively withdraw temperature from affected model ids while preserving it for others.

A provider-agnostic error translation in src/rebar/llm/failure.py must convert a 400 ValidationException naming a sampling parameter into an actionable LLMConfigError that names the model id, the parameter, and both remedies (add the id to _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES or unset temperature config), without introducing a provider-name branch.

The Bedrock builder must ship in a new leaf module src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py rather than in providers.py, because providers.py is at 289 LOC against a 300-LOC attested criterion from story 7468, and the [bedrock] optional extra must be added to the dev install group so live tests run in CI without breaching the no-boto3 constraint on the default [agents] install.
